description: This file declares the class AdbLegacyIOCompletion, which encapsulates a wrapper around the Windows OVERLAPPED structure for asynchronous USB I/O operations in the context of ADB (Android Debug Bridge) legacy USB API. It includes method declarations for handling overlapped I/O results, and manages associated resources related to USB endpoint objects and I/O completion handling.

classes.name: AdbLegacyIOCompletion
classes.description: A wrapper around the OVERLAPPED structure for asynchronous USB I/O, providing methods to retrieve I/O results and manage associated endpoint and transfer details.

methods.name: AdbLegacyIOCompletion
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with parent endpoint, expected transfer size, event handle, and I/O type flag.

methods.name: ~AdbLegacyIOCompletion
methods.description: Destructor, intentionally hidden to prevent Stack allocation.

methods.name: GetOvelappedIoResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of an overlapped I/O operation using GetOverlappedResult, with options to wait for completion.

methods.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject * parent_legacy_io_object() const
methods.description: Returns the parent endpoint object associated with this I/O completion.

methods.name: bool is_write_ioctl() const
methods.description: Indicates whether this I/O completion was created for a bulk write operation.

methods.name: ULONG * transferred_bytes_ptr()
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the number of transferred bytes for a write operation.
